note: Untitled doc §13–16 (Phase E). Difficulty presets, optional modifiers, Death-Block and game modes. A modifier or mode with status "planned" is listed but cannot be picked.

difficulties.name: Story
difficulties.blurb: Gentler enemies. For enjoying the campaign.

difficulties.name: Nightmare
difficulties.blurb: For the end of the road.

deathBlock.rule: If your whole party faints in your first 5 battles, you go back to the start of the stage with your party healed. Works once per run.

modifiers.name: No Transformations
modifiers.blurb: Mega, Tera, Z-Moves and Dynamax are off for both sides.

modifiers.name: Scarce Supplies
modifiers.blurb: You start with half the money and half the items.

modifiers.name: Monotype
modifiers.blurb: Every Pokémon you keep must share a type with your starter.

modifiers.name: Single Region Dex
modifiers.blurb: Wild and trainer Pokémon come only from one randomly chosen generation.

modifiers.name: Rich Route
modifiers.blurb: 25% more money from battles, but every enemy is 2 levels higher.

modifiers.name: Blind Research
modifiers.blurb: The map hides each stage's theme until you arrive. Research Points x1.5.

modifiers.name: No Revives
modifiers.blurb: Revive items never appear in rewards or shops.

modifiers.name: Random Draft
modifiers.blurb: Your draft rule is picked at random (from the ones with no license).

modifiers.name: Boss Rush
modifiers.blurb: A shorter campaign: 4 stages per region, so gyms and leagues come twice as often.

modifiers.name: Variant Hunt
modifiers.blurb: Event stops are 50% more common. Ordinary forms are unchanged and shiny odds do not change.

modifiers.name: Limited Party
modifiers.blurb: Your party holds at most 4 Pokémon.

modifiers.name: No Duplicate Species
modifiers.blurb: Only one Pokémon of each evolution line in your party.

modifiers.name: Contract: Empty Bag
modifiers.blurb: Challenge Contract: only Poké Balls can be used in battle.

modifiers.name: Contract: No Rest
modifiers.blurb: Challenge Contract: healing stops on the map can't be used.

modifiers.name: Contract: No Evolution
modifiers.blurb: Challenge Contract: nothing evolves, by level or by item.

modifiers.name: Boss Remix
modifiers.blurb: Gym leaders, the Elite Four and champions lead with different Pokémon and a different ace.

modifiers.name: Speed Clear
modifiers.blurb: Opt-in. Win a trainer battle in 6 turns or fewer for an extra ₽150. There is no timer and no penalty for taking longer.

modifiers.name: Solo Run
modifiers.blurb: Your party holds only one Pokémon.

modifiers.name: Quick Route (old practice option)
modifiers.blurb: Retired: Quick Route is now a mode. Runs saved with this option still load.

modes.name: Quick Route
modes.blurb: A real run on a shorter road (3 stages per region). Achievements, unlocks and rewards count, but account rewards pay 60% because the road is shorter.

modes.name: Standard
modes.blurb: The roguelike. A wipe ends the run.

modes.name: Adventure
modes.blurb: No restart on a wipe: you go back to the start of the stage. No Bank Credits, Research Points, candies, unlocks or achievements.

modes.name: Daily Run
modes.blurb: One shared run per day: the date sets the seed, a fixed starter set, one daily modifier and a short one-region route to the champion. Rewards pay once per day; replays are for practice.

modes.name: Endless
modes.blurb: No final victory: beat the last champion and the regions start again, enemies +5 levels each loop. The run ends when you wipe.

modes.name: Spooky
modes.blurb: Spooky forms haunt the wild: about 1 in 4 wild Pokémon is replaced by a Spooky form.

modes.name: Draft Lab
modes.blurb: A place to experiment: the starter set and draft rule are random every run. No permanent rewards.

modes.name: Regional Circuit
modes.blurb: A shorter run through one region picked by the seed: its trainers, its Pokémon, its gyms. Half the usual account rewards.

modes.name: Research Expedition
modes.blurb: Event-heavy routes with fewer ordinary battles and scarce supplies (half the starting money and items).

modes.name: Nuzlocke
modes.blurb: One catch per area (the first wild Pokémon you meet). A Pokémon that faints is lost for good and joins the memorial. A wipe ends the run. Rewards +25%.

modes.name: Hardcore Nuzlocke
modes.blurb: Nuzlocke, plus: the party can't pass the stage's level cap margin, only Poké Balls in battle, and Set style (no switching in trainer battles). Rewards +60%.

modes.name: Modifier Run
modes.blurb: Every 5 battles you pick 1 of 3 blessings or curses. They stack all run long. Curses raise your end rewards.

modes.name: Weekly Gauntlet
modes.blurb: The week decides the seed, the three starters and one themed ruleset (Nuzlocke, Monotype, Empty Bag...). Same for everyone; your best score is kept on this device. Account rewards pay once a week.
